title: Add continuously visible bottom buying button (persistent CTA)

requirements.text:
Add a persistent bottom “buying” CTA that stays continuously visible at the bottom of the viewport while the user scrolls the landing page, and ensure it triggers the existing UPI payment flow.

- Implement this as a sticky/fixed bottom bar rendered on the landing page (`frontend/src/pages/TechifyLandingPage.tsx`).
- The bottom CTA must call the existing `initiatePayment` function from `useUpiPayment(...)` (same behavior as the hero CTA buttons, including deep-link + fallback dialog).
- Ensure the bottom bar is visible across common screen sizes (mobile and desktop) and does not obscure important content (add appropriate bottom padding/margin to the page content so the last sections remain readable and tappable).
- Keep all user-facing text in English.

quotes: it should show buying button below continously

acceptanceCriteria: When scrolling anywhere on the landing page, a bottom “buy” CTA remains visible at the bottom of the screen.
Clicking/tapping the bottom CTA triggers the same payment behavior as the existing hero CTAs (calls `initiatePayment` from `useUpiPayment(...)` and shows the existing fallback dialog when needed).

On both mobile and desktop viewports, the persistent bottom bar does not cover/obstruct the page’s content; the user can still access the footer and last section content without it being hidden behind the bar.
All text shown in the bottom CTA/bar is in English.

constraints: Do not edit files under the immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose existing UI components instead).
Keep the existing UPI deep-link + fallback dialog approach; do not introduce new payment providers or backend dependencies.
nonGoals: Changing backend canister logic or adding backend purchase tracking.
Adding new routing/pages beyond the existing single-page landing page.
Changing the existing hero CTA labels or WhatsApp flows unless required to wire the persistent CTA to the same payment behavior.
